sourceRefs.locator: Object description, first paragraph. Found near Thorn in 2009, struck at Maastricht around 625, its two inscriptions and moneyer.

The Oxford Handbook of the Merovingian World, pp. 772–774 and figs. 34.1–34.3. River settlements, two moneyers at Dorestad before its later port, Madelinus in the 630s and 640s and possible uses for gold coins.
Object 18208309, legends and commentary after the bibliography. Parallel specimen. The name is also known at Maastricht and probably continued after the moneyer’s death.

summary.de: Madelinus erscheint auf Prägungen mit den Ortsnamen Maastricht und Dorestad. Spätere Prägungen konnten seinen Namen beibehalten.
summary.en: Coins from Maastricht and Dorestad name Madelinus. Later issues could retain his name.
